QuestInfo.name: Lifesaver
QuestInfo.0: You saved the person stuck at the top of the #m701101030# building. Find out more about him.
QuestInfo.1: The name of the person stuck atop the #m701101030# building is #p9310535#, and he's a reporter for the Shanghai Tribune. \r\nBuy him a #t2030056:# so he can return to Yu Garden.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You saved the reporter, #p9310535#, who got stuck after getting chased by #o9600313# while covering the strange things happening in Shanghai. You obtained a #t2030056:# for #p9310535# to return safely to Yu Garden, but he asks you to go with him. \r\nHe has a small reward and something urgent to say...
